thread:
anya: Quick note / kodiak-lite (int4) bring-up on multilingual-KB holdout: recall@5 down ~8pt vs kodiak-v1 fp16, biggest hits on short non-English queries. putting raw numbers below. :flag_fr: :flag_es:
tom: Which quant scheme did you use? per-tensor or per-channel? asymmetric?
anya: Per-tensor asymmetric, 4-bit blocksize=64, no residuals. eval run: `./run_eval.sh --model kodiak-lite-int4 --holdout multilingual_holdout_2026.json --k 5 --metric recall`
felix: Can you paste recall by language and by length?
anya: Quick table pasted:
```
baseline kodiak-v1 fp16: en_short: 0.81, en_long: 0.87, fr_short: 0.78, fr_long: 0.84, es_short: 0.76, es_long: 0.83
kodiak-lite int4:   en_short: 0.79, en_long: 0.85, fr_short: 0.65, fr_long: 0.80, es_short: 0.62, es_long: 0.78
```
non-en shorts are worst.
lina: Any change in embedding angle / norm? maybe small-dim collapse for shorter sequences in other languages.
anya: Stats: mean L2 norm by bucket:
```
baseline mean L2: en_short 6.0, fr_short 5.8, es_short 5.7
int4 mean L2:     en_short 5.8, fr_short 3.9, es_short 3.7
```
angle (cosine) between positives dropped ~0.03 for fr/es shorts.
tom: That screams scale-shift + alignment issue across tokenizers / BPE when quantizing. Try per-language affine calibration + unit-renorm.
felix: Also test PCA-whitening fit on the multilingual training sample and apply to both baseline and int4 to keep projection consistent. we've had success with cross-lingual cluster overlap improvements.
anya: KMeans silhouette (k=40) baseline 0.39 -> int4 0.22. UMAP shows fr/es short clusters dispersed.
eval-bot: scheduled eval job 6167890010: `kodiak-int4-lang-calib` (ETA ~8m).
ops-bot: index rebuild queued: IVF-PQ (M=64) vs HNSW for brute checks.
felix: For triage, do neighbor-rerank: brute top-200 then rerank with a tiny cross-encoder (distillation head) to see if rerank can recover recall. if yes, then representation still has signal but ranking precision flawed.
anya: Started per-lang scale + unit-renorm run. also trying per-tensor zero-point adjust and blocksize=128.
eval-bot: job 6167890010 completed: per-lang affine + unit-renorm recovered fr_short 0.68 -> 0.72, es_short 0.62 -> 0.70. overall recall@5 gap narrowed to ~3pt. results: /evals/6167890010/summary.json
tom: Good partial recovery. Next: PCA-whiten + per-lang calibration + rebuild HNSW index with cosine distance. also run cross-lingual retrieval evaluation (translate-then-search vs direct) to measure alignment.
anya: Adding next-step checklist: 1) PCA-whiten full multilingual sample (anya) 2) neighbor-rerank probe (felix) 3) index-type sensitivity (ops-bot) 4) tokenizer compatibility check (lina) 5) small cross-encoder fallback for short non-en queries (tom).
felix: I'll prepare a minimal repro notebook showing norm collapse for fr/es short inputs and push to /notebooks/kodiak-int4-debug.ipynb.
anya: Thanks all. I'll post UMAPs and the job summaries once the PCA run finishes. :eyes:
